title: Chapter 6880: Linked Penta-Stars

Chapter 6880: Linked Penta-Stars

Chapter 6880: Linked Penta-stars

“Devour Nine Abysses.” Immortal Devourer threw his cauldron at the opponent.

It hovered above the youth’s head, absorbed all of space, and came crashing down. It had killed immortals like this in the past.

Strands of light oozed from the mouth, looking like creepy tongues wiping away all affinities.

“Soaring Ruyi!” The youth’s jade floated above, capable of stopping any power with its rotation.

The cauldron smashed against the jade but was stopped entirely. Meanwhile, the youth flipped his palm and summoned immortal runes containing mystical dao. Each rune was as heavy as a world.

“Blessed Variation, Endless Dao.” He tossed them into the air and they soared like dragons toward the cauldron.

“Boom!” A total of three thousand runes flew into the cauldron, wishing to tear it to pieces from within.

“Devour!” Immortal Devourer's expression darkened as he utilized his true blood as well.

Within the cauldron, a gigantic dark mouth attempted to swallow and refine the runic dragons.

“High Heaven Rune.” The youth tossed out another rune. Once it became close enough, it split into countless heavenly talismans and wrapped around the cauldron like a kasaya.

“Crackle!” Lightning bolts and flames ignited afterward.

Immortal Devourer immediately channeled his dao power to withstand the refinement. The youth did the same to accelerate the process.

This became a contest of raw energy between the two golden immortals. Just like the previous battles, determining a victor required a long time. In this case, it would be the depletion of their energy.

“Devouring Light!” On the other side of the battlefield, Mirage and the others finally built a usable defense to stop the sound waves.

Except for Netherlight, the other immortals belonged to the last generation and had fought together before. Moreover, they merely warped their dao and power into the devouring affinity. The powers didn’t conflict with each other.

The devouring power attempted to devour the waves, allowing them to return to offense.

On the other hand, the Guardian’s immortals roared and used their vitality, hoping for the roars to become stronger with time.

Stygian began feeling the destructive effects of both fights. Existences hidden in the shadow cowered in fear, overlords included.

“Buzz.” Five stars appeared above the battlefield and connected together.

“Five stars?” Bear Immortal was the first to notice them. He has been in Stygian long enough to know who they represented.

“Dark Realm’s Linked Penta-stars! Be careful!” He was ready to swing his banner again.

These five immortals were renowned for having impeccable teamwork and incredible moves.

Sure enough, the stars turned into five old men.

“Gather.” They spoke in unison and the stars’ light expanded rapidly.

“Dark Desire, Incinerate!” They roared before unleashing a technique affecting all of Stygian.
